label: Tower
blurb: All players roll their Zodiac Die. Each player who rolls 7 or lower has one of their Coal Extinguished, their own cho…
detailHtml: All players roll their Zodiac Die. Each player who rolls 7 or lower has one of their Coal Extinguished, their own choice which. Wards apply.

label: Death
blurb: All players return their Hand cards to the Kismeta Deck. The Agekeeper shuffles. Spreads and Arcanums are untouched.
detailHtml: All players return their Hand cards to the Kismeta Deck. The Agekeeper shuffles. Spreads and Arcanums are untouched.

label: The Sun
blurb: The Furnaces blaze. Until Transit, every player's Heat is raised by 2 in every Element.
detailHtml: The Furnaces blaze. Until Transit, every player's Heat is raised by 2 in every Element.

label: Judgement
blurb: Until Transit, a Duel challenger must beat the defender's roll by 2 or more to win.
detailHtml: Until Transit, a Duel challenger must beat the defender's roll by 2 or more to win.

label: Justice
blurb: All players count their Reagents. The player holding the most gives half of them, rounded down, to the player holding…
detailHtml: All players count their Reagents. The player holding the most gives half of them, rounded down, to the player holding the fewest. Ties are broken by turn order from the Agekeeper.

label: The Moon
blurb: A lunar eclipse darkens the Summer sun. No Duels and no Sieges may be declared until Transit.
detailHtml: A lunar eclipse darkens the Summer sun. No Duels and no Sieges may be declared until Transit.

label: The Fool
blurb: The Agekeeper draws one Crucible Card at random from those unused in setup and places it face up on the table. The fi…
detailHtml: The Agekeeper draws one Crucible Card at random from those unused in setup and places it face up on the table. The first player to assemble its Card Set claims it, and exchanges it for any one of their unfired Crucible Cards, which returns to the box.

label: Wheel of Fortune
blurb: All players roll their Zodiac Die. The highest roll draws 3 cards from the Kismeta Deck into their Spread. The lowest…
detailHtml: All players roll their Zodiac Die. The highest roll draws 3 cards from the Kismeta Deck into their Spread. The lowest roll returns half their Hand cards, rounded down, to the Kismeta Deck. Ties are broken by turn order from the Agekeeper.

label: The Hanged Man
blurb: All Adept cards are Severed until Transit. Their printed text does nothing.
detailHtml: All Adept cards are Severed until Transit. Their printed text does nothing.

label: The Lovers
blurb: All players roll their Zodiac Die and add the results together. If the total passes the threshold for the player coun…
detailHtml: All players roll their Zodiac Die and add the results together. If the total passes the threshold for the player count, every player takes any 3 Reagents from the supply. Thresholds: 2 players 13, 3 players 19, 4 players 26.

label: The Magician

Sign: Gemini · Element: Air · Planet: Mercury · Price: Quicksilver

  • Resonant: Any Neutralize card in your Spread cancels any one Reversed effect, whatever its suit.

  • Resonant: Scry 3, or Scry a rival's Hand. Roll 7 or higher to take any 2 cards.

label: The Aces · Sun & Wild Charge
blurb: Wild for Stelliums and usable as a Seed when paying Formulas.
detailHtml: Aces carry the Sun and are wild for any one Stellium, chosen freely. At most one Ace may count toward any one Stellium. An Ace is also a Seed: spend it when paying an Alchemical Formula and it counts as 1 Reagent of its Suit. There are 8 Aces in the deck, two per Suit.

label: Card Effect Verbs
blurb: Burn, Extinguish, Neutralize, Reversed, Ward, Sever, Scry, and Distill.
detailHtml:
• Burn: Discard this card to use the effect that follows.
  • Extinguish: Remove one Coal from a Furnace. It returns to its owner's supply and their Heat in that Element drops by 1. A Ward can stop it.
  • Neutralize: Cancel the Reversed effect of a card in your Spread. Both cards remain in play.
  • Reversed: A penalty that applies only while this card is in your Spread. Moving it to your Hand, or Neutralizing it, ends the penalty.
  • Ward: The warded card, Stone, or resource cannot be targeted, as the card states.
  • Sever: Switch off one card's printed text until Transit, as the card states.
  • Scry X: Look at the top X cards of the Kismeta Deck, or a rival's Hand, as the card states. What you learn is yours to keep.
  • Distill: Spend 3 Essence of one Element to take the Reagent of that Element.
